name: Shopify
one_liner: E-commerce platform whose APIs let apps read and write store products, orders, customers, and inventory.
auth_notes: Per-store access token (offline or online) obtained after merchant install/scope approval (auth code or token exchange, client credentials later), sent in X-Shopify-Access-Token. Storefront and Customer Account APIs use their own tokens.
access_notes: Dev Dashboard and free dev stores are self-serve for building. Some scopes need Shopify's approval and public apps need protected-customer-data approval; App Store listing is reviewed. Whether a Partner account costs anything is not stated on fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Broad documented GraphQL Admin API, free dev stores, standard OAuth. Caveats: per-store install, approval for some scopes and protected customer data, plan-based rate limits.

needs_human_reason: Shopify MCP found is a coding-agent AI Toolkit; no official store-data MCP URL confirmed. Partner account cost and scope-approval details not verified.

identity.quote: Shopify apps call the GraphQL Admin API to read and write store data on behalf of merchants.

auth.quote: Your app sends the token in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header on every GraphQL Admin API request.

access.quote: Shopify grants some access scopes to individual apps rather than to every app that declares them.
Fields that return a customer's personal data need a separate approval if your app is public.

sandbox.quote: Dev stores: You own them, for building and testing without touching a live store.

api_surface.quote: Every API applies limits differently, so the figures and the mechanics are documented with each API
Pagination of arrays of objects caps at 25,000 objects
it can subscribe to Shopify webhook topics as a mechanism for receiving near-real-time data about these events

mcp.quote: Shopify AI Toolkit gives your AI coding tool a Shopify-aware starting point.

disputes.why: Dev Dashboard and free dev stores are self-serve; gated scopes and protected customer data approval are explicit.
OAuth install flow plus X-Shopify-Access-Token header documented.
Docs name Shopify approval for some scopes and protected customer data for public apps.
Separate approval needed for protected customer data if app is public.
